description: A React component implementing a virtualized table with custom styling, using libraries like antd, react-window, and styled-components. It supports dynamic column widths, HTML content rendering, and pagination handling.

classes.name: VirtualTable
classes.description: A React functional component for rendering a virtualized, scrollable table with customizable columns and pagination.

methods.name: onPageChange
methods.description: Handles page change events, resets vertical scroll, and proxies the event with additional pagination info.

methods.name: renderVirtualList
methods.description: Renders the virtualized list of table rows using react-window's Grid component.

methods.name: resetVirtualGrid
methods.description: Resets the virtual grid's internal state after resize or column changes.
